== Summary ==
Identified: [[Dion Erbes]]. "Dion" is Dion Erbes, the only Dion in the standings; several players are in frame and the source does not mark which one he is.

== Description ==

Game 3: "Dion returns!" At the [[May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (25 May)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 25 May 2003.
